fields.description:
**Summary:** Two July asks have no card and no recorded answer. Confirm whether each is still needed.

* Does moving a Sign-Up to In Progress send a welcome email? (Jul 22, Aug 4)
* What is the final set of required fields before a Sign-Up can be Complete? The completion lock seems to exist only on the page layout (no validation rule). Also: can a banned player's Sign-Up reach Complete? Emily said no on Aug 18, but the build does not block it.

**Done when:** Emily answers each item, and each "yes" becomes a story.

**Sources (traceable):**

* Weekly sync, 2026-07-22 (welcome email) — https://fathom.video/calls/752785644
* Weekly sync, 2026-07-28 (Complete gating fields) — https://fathom.video/calls/762006108
